modelDescription: Designed to work with stock Glock magazine spring. Will work on all full size double stacked GLOCKs. Overall weight 0.75 oz. Length, 0.5 Inch. Patented proven push pin design. Super easy to attach and detach from the magazine. No specialty tools or devices required to disassemble. One piece design, no extra parts to possibly lose during disassembly. Fits the USPSA 140mm gauge. Ideal for full size magazines. CNC machined from billet aluminum. Hard Anodized. Made in the USA. Used and endorsed by World and National Champions the GLOCK Shooting Team, Randi Rogers, Allie Barrett, and of course Taran Butler.
